title: Setback for AIADMK as 4 ex-ministers join TVK
description: Four former ministers including two MLAs from the All India Anna Dravida Munnetra Kazhagam (AIADMK) joined the ruling Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam (TVK) party on Thursday, marking the latest political blow for the Dravidian party in the two months since the assembly election
